bull.b: Micron has delivered a major rebound in revenue and profitability, demonstrating strong current demand for its memory portfolio and improved product economics. This earnings base supports internal investment, strengthens operating leverage, and provides meaningful momentum into the next several quarters.

bull.t: Strong Cash Generation and Balance Sheet
bull.b: Exceptional operating and free cash flow, together with a substantial net cash position, gives Micron flexibility to fund capacity expansion, technology development, debt reduction, and shareholder returns. This financial strength also improves resilience when memory conditions eventually weaken.

bull.t: Strategic Customer Agreements Improve Demand Visibility
bull.b: Strategic customer agreements can make a portion of Micron’s demand base more visible and align product planning with major customers. Broadening SCA coverage toward more than half of revenue could support capacity decisions, deepen relationships, and reduce reliance on purely spot-market demand.

bear.b: Micron’s profitability remains highly exposed to memory supply, demand, and average selling price cycles. The sharp movement from losses to peak-like margins means current earnings power may not persist, creating material risk to revenue, margins, and cash generation when industry conditions normalize.

bear.t: Heavy and Rising Capital and Operating Costs
bear.b: Large and increasing investment requirements raise the cash commitment needed to support Micron’s capacity and technology roadmap. Higher operating expenses and startup costs may also pressure free cash flow and margins, particularly if new capacity ramps more slowly than expected.

bear.t: Persistent Supply Constraints and Manufacturing Complexity
bear.b: Extended industry constraints can limit Micron’s ability to convert strong demand into shipment growth and may complicate customer allocation. While tight supply can support pricing, prolonged capacity and infrastructure bottlenecks increase execution demands and restrict the company’s flexibility to respond.
